datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET field enumerators on a monthly basis throughout 2014 and spatially referenced to administrative units in Mauritania. The classifications represent assessments of acute food insecurity phases across different scenarios, aggregated into geographic polygons with associated metadata on collection date, classification scale, and assistance eligibility.
